recording.author: Codex

chapters.title: Setsuna · one deposit, transparent allocation
chapters.detail: This is the public web demo. Earn leads, with Spot and Perps alongside it.

chapters.title: Start with test funds
chapters.detail: The faucet supplies synthetic MON for gas, USDC for Earn/Spot, and AUSD for Perps.

chapters.title: Deposit 100 USDC
chapters.detail: Approve only the deposit amount. The vault then issues setsUSDC receipt shares.

chapters.title: Inspect the actual vault holdings
chapters.detail: Five fixed lending integrations plus cash. A new deposit can remain idle until a permitted rebalance.

chapters.title: See why the vault moves—or waits
chapters.detail: The contract reports its decision at the displayed block. The cooldown and movement limits still apply.

chapters.title: Compare the recorded rate inputs
chapters.detail: The allocation rule uses conservative base-rate observations. Rates are not guaranteed returns or a complete risk score.

chapters.title: Verify executed events
chapters.detail: Each receipt links to the same fork’s explorer. A proposed allocation is different from a completed move.

chapters.title: Withdraw the available position
chapters.detail: Redeem setsUSDC into USDC. Availability depends on cash and lending-market liquidity.

chapters.title: Spot · MON / USDC through Kuru
chapters.detail: This supporting workspace uses wallet assets. Earn shares do not automatically fund trades.

chapters.title: Perps · AUSD collateral through Perpl
chapters.detail: Perps is separate from Earn. This fork demo uses a fixed historical BTC mark of $82,964.20.

chapters.title: Try it yourself · inspect the evidence
chapters.detail: setsuna-metropolis.vercel.app · Recorded receipts and limits are available on the Evidence page.

recording.scope: Real public fork funding and USDC deposit/full withdrawal, signed through an injected test wallet. Spot and Perps screens shown without new trades. Recording captions are an overlay, not application state. No clock changes or administrator RPC.
recording.editing: Uncut browser recording with explanatory captions, followed by a five-second card for the newly linked primary domain. Silent video. No chain-time advancement.
